portal.meta.description: Tellux 是一个基于 Three.js 的开源 3D Earth Engine，用于构建数字地球、数字孪生、三维地图以及各类 3D Earth 应用。
Tellux is an open-source Three.js 3D Earth Engine for digital earth, digital twins, 3D maps, and other 3D Earth apps.
portal.meta.title: Tellux - Three.js 3D Earth Engine
Tellux - Three.js 3D Earth Engine
portal.hero.title:
用 Three.js
组织可扩展的
3D Earth 应用

Build scalable
3D Earth apps
with Three.js
portal.hero.body: Tellux 将 3D Tiles、Cesium 地形、影像图层、地球相机、大气、体积云和后处理能力封装成更贴近 Cesium / mapboxgl 使用习惯的 TypeScript API。
Tellux wraps 3D Tiles, Cesium terrain, imagery layers, earth camera, atmosphere, volumetric clouds, and post-processing into a TypeScript API familiar to Cesium / mapboxgl users.
portal.capabilities.title: 把底层渲染能力收束成 GIS 开发者熟悉的入口
Package low-level rendering into GIS-friendly APIs
portal.capabilities.body: Tellux 不替代 Three.js，而是在 Three.js、3d-tiles-renderer 与 Takram geospatial 生态之上提供应用侧封装。
Tellux does not replace Three.js; it adds an application layer on Three.js, 3d-tiles-renderer, and the Takram geospatial stack.

Terrain, atmosphere, and volumetric cloud showcase
portal.showcase.terrain.aria: 真实地形与大气效果展示
portal.showcase.terrain.alt: Tellux 渲染的雪山地形、低角度太阳和预计算大气散射效果
Tellux-rendered snowy terrain with low-angle sun and precomputed atmospheric scattering
portal.showcase.terrain.title: 真实地形和预计算大气一起进入工程视图
Real terrain and precomputed atmosphere in an engineering view
portal.showcase.terrain.body: Tellux 可以在 Cesium quantized-mesh 地形上叠加影像纹理，并结合预计算大气 LUT、太阳光和天空光探针，让远山雾化、低空暖光和雪线明暗关系保持稳定。它不是展示页滤镜，而是面向三维 GIS 场景的实时渲染基础。

Overlay imagery on Cesium quantized-mesh terrain with precomputed atmosphere LUTs, sunlight, and sky probes—stable haze, warm low light, and snowline contrast. Not a demo filter; a realtime 3D GIS rendering foundation.
portal.showcase.clouds.videoAria: Tellux 渲染的体积云随视角推进和光照变化的效果
Tellux volumetric clouds responding to camera motion and lighting
portal.showcase.clouds.title: 把云层作为真实空间体积参与场景表达
Treat clouds as real volumetric volumes in the scene
portal.showcase.clouds.body: Tellux 的体积云沿用物理光照和大气合成流程，云体会随相机高度、太阳方向和曝光设置呈现连续的层次变化。从近地平线的厚重云墙到高空俯视的柔和云海，它都能和地形、天空、后处理保持统一的空间关系。
Physically lit volumetric clouds with atmospheric compositing—continuous layering with camera height, sun direction, and exposure, consistent with terrain, sky, and post-processing.
